purpose: Codable PhoenixGuard V3 market-knowledge vocabulary for supply/demand, trendlines, candlestick filters, replay explanation, and future VLM narration.

authority_rules.execution_authority: This dictionary explains and scores context only. The Book Strategy Master playbook is the final strategy decider, and only a fresh validated PG_EXECUTION_PACKET_V3 can authorize action.
authority_rules.visible_labels: Operator-visible overlay labels must still come from docs/phoenixguard_v3_visual_dictionary.json.
authority_rules.vlm_role: The VLM explains PhoenixGuard state in English. It must not invent independent predictions or create unapproved labels.

source_material.file: book knowledge/The power of Japanese candlestick charts _ advanced filtering techniques for trading stocks, futures and Forex ( PDFDrive ).pdf
source_material.focus: Candlestick morphology, reversal/continuation patterns, confirmation, filtering and pattern reliability.
FX market structure, liquidity, session risk, support/resistance causes, candle setups and risk context.

support_resistance.principle: Support and resistance are zones, not exact prices.
support_resistance.visual_boundary: Horizontal areas render as SUPPLY_ZONE or DEMAND_ZONE overlays. Support/resistance words may remain metadata, but visible horizontal boxes must display SUPPLY or DEMAND.
anti_patterns: Do not treat exact-line S/R as sufficient.
Do not enter from a zone without path room to opposing force.
Do not count a broken stale zone as live authority without reclaim or role-flip evidence.

trendlines.principle: Major trendlines use obvious outer swing anchors; inner trendlines use local pivots for timing only.
trendlines.visual_boundary: Diagonal support/resistance renders in the TRENDLINES mode/layer as SUPPORT_TRENDLINE, RESISTANCE_TRENDLINE, or INNER_TRENDLINE. Horizontal support/resistance must not be rendered as a trendline.
book_rules: A support trendline connects at least two higher lows or troughs.
A resistance trendline connects at least two lower highs or peaks.
The line must touch the selected anchors.
There must be no price obstruction between point 1 and point 2.
A significant body close beyond the line invalidates the active line.
Inner trendlines are local timing deciders and must not override the major outer line.
anti_patterns: Reject lines that do not touch both anchors.
Reject lines that cut through intervening candles between anchors.
Do not let an inner trendline override a nearby opposing major line.
Treat wick probes differently from body-close breaches.

candlestick_filters.principle: Candlestick patterns are tactical evidence and require location, trend context and confirmation.
candlestick_filters.score_shape: morphology_score * location_score * trend_alignment_score * confirmation_score * filter_score * freshness_decay
anti_patterns: Do not trade a candle pattern in the middle of range without stronger confirmation.
Do not render candle pattern names as live labels unless they are intentionally approved.
Do not fade overbought or oversold conditions blindly.

order_positioning.principle: Detect observable chart structure first, derive order-positioning evidence second, publish selected geometry once at an identity-proven closed candle, and observe it continuously without moving its source anchors.
order_positioning.taxonomy_authority: Use exchange and regulator order semantics. The Art of Currency Trading supports the same taxonomy; FOREX BLACK BOOK page 20 is retained for structure concepts but is not authoritative for order naming.
placement_rules: BUY_LIMIT_ZONE must be below the origin price and overlap validated lower support, demand, role-flip, or pullback structure.
SELL_LIMIT_ZONE must be above the origin price and overlap validated higher resistance, supply, role-flip, or rally structure.
BUY_STOP_ENTRY_ZONE is a narrow strip above a validated resistance, range, flag, or confirmation-candle high.
SELL_STOP_ENTRY_ZONE is a narrow strip below a validated support, range, flag, or confirmation-candle low.
PROTECTIVE_STOP_ZONE belongs beyond the source structure or full candle-pattern extreme with a chart-noise buffer and must never overlap an entry area.
A candlestick pattern contributes evidence only when location, trend, confirmation, filtering, and freshness agree.
A sweep reversal requires the visible level, sweep, reclaim, structure confirmation, activation strip, and protection beyond the sweep extreme in that order.

immutable_publication.publication_anchor: latest identity-proven closed candle when all positioning evidence gates pass
immutable_publication.late_chase_rule: If price has already travelled beyond a fresh opportunity, mark MISSED or LATE_CHASE and do not create a replacement box at the current candle.

order_positioning.training_boundary: Current BUY and SELL screenshots are direction labels, not order-zone ground truth. Train vision on observable candles, swings, breaks, reclaims, zones and trendline anchors; train a final positioning detector only after expert-reviewed closed-candle-anchored bounding-box annotations exist.
anti_patterns: Do not infer actual resting broker orders from a chart screenshot.
Do not use the same type for an entry stop and a protective stop.
Do not move published candidate geometry to follow each new candle.
Do not regenerate an entry after the move is already several candles in progress.
Do not let an overlay authorize a trade.

advanced_continuous_study.principle: Every new identity-proven closed candle can extend bounded historical study exactly once. Repeated frames are idempotent, and no manual baseline or fixed-length run is required.
advanced_continuous_study.continuous_integration: MarketStudyServiceV3 rebuilds ontology and drift deterministically from restart-safe continuous history. CrossPairStudyCoordinatorV3 atomically retains bounded normalized-return tails and publishes an insufficient synchronized-pair or support state instead of inventing a peer or edge.

hierarchical_motif_lattice.bounds: maximum depth 4 and maximum 2048 published nodes per level

time_to_event_survival.method: Kaplan-Meier-style historical curves with explicit right censoring and Greenwood log-log intervals
time_to_event_survival.authority: descriptive duration evidence only; not a future deadline or causal claim

adaptive_feature_ontology.promotion_gate: closed-candle-only, temporal precedence, no future leakage, deterministic derivation, coordinate/order preservation, support, holdout stability, and multiplicity-adjusted association evidence
adaptive_feature_ontology.authority: passing the gate permits public study use only and does not establish causation

exact_historical_path.normalization: median candle range computed only from geometry known at the anchor

joint_path_clock_liquidity_field.duration_policy: new anchors require 900 through 7200 seconds; admitted anchors continue through the final clock but cannot open a new entry below 900 seconds remaining
joint_path_clock_liquidity_field.close_time_proof: source bar identity and source market time are independent evidence; screenshot-only time requires one resolver-confirmed close bracketed across one exact timeframe boundary and bound to the same pair, timeframe, event key, sequence, and row
joint_path_clock_liquidity_field.forbidden_clock_substitutes: capture time, publish time, frame number, x position, an initial screenshot baseline, and interpolated gap timestamps
joint_path_clock_liquidity_field.promotion_gate: minimum replay support plus simultaneous improvement in direction, timing, sweep survival, and calibration
joint_path_clock_liquidity_field.persistence: raw paths and freezes stay in a dedicated bounded atomic side store; Pair DNA receives compact aggregates only
joint_path_clock_liquidity_field.authority: timing may delay or veto an existing permission but can never create direction, entry permission, or execution authority

cross_pair_association_graph.requirements: distinct pairs, exact shared closed timestamps, one compatible normalized coordinate space, and one order domain
cross_pair_association_graph.methods: bounded explicitly non-causal Granger-style residual-variance-reduction proxy plus mutual information and deterministic circular-shift significance
cross_pair_association_graph.live_coordinator: bounded restart-safe normalized-return state with exact-timestamp synchronization and explicit INSUFFICIENT_SYNCHRONIZED_PAIR or INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT abstention
cross_pair_association_graph.authority: explicitly non-causal association only; never proof of influence, direction, prediction, or entry

online_concept_drift.method: adjacent bounded-window two-sample KS evidence with per-feature multiplicity control and a standardized mean-shift floor
online_concept_drift.authority: distribution-change evidence only; not directional evidence

study_claim_proof.authority: content integrity only; it does not authenticate the market source, prove causation, or grant entry or execution permission

risk_notes: Prefer liquid pairs for short-term overlays.
Downweight thin liquidity windows and high jump-risk periods.
Correlation is valid only when logical drivers agree.

replay.principle: Replay objects explain historical would-have behavior and never provide live execution authority.
